dogecoin.text: First part of talk - how truebit enables transferring coins from doge to eth. What does our smart contract need to do? We need to provide a merkle proof that the coins are locked in doge coin. This means we need to maintain list of doge headers in ethereum!

So he proposes there are crosses to exchange doge for WOW. 

Slide is informative. Thing is to mint the wow token and securely. You need some way to ensure doge coin can be returned. No new op code required, based on incentive. https://t.co/O4bfMM2t0k

Biggest challenge is to get doge coin to add a new “locked” doge coin. 

There is a bit of history between doge and ethereum https://t.co/0LtPMIzwN4

There are theee challenges. Effiency of the relay; you want to check individual transactions coming across and the proof of work of dogecoin (too hard to do in a smart contract). Maintain a 1-1 ratio of doge to minted WoW https://t.co/dwSRngm2ml
